tools.title: Docker Hub
tools.summary: Public and private container image registry: repositories, tags, image search.

servers.name: Docker Hub MCP Server

settings.name: hub_username
settings.description: Docker Hub: the username that owns the personal access token

servers.capabilities: Search images and Docker Hardened Images, read repository info, tags and Dockerfiles; create repositories and update repository info and Dockerfiles.
servers.scopes: The rights of the Docker Hub personal access token. Consent: Create a PAT with the least permissions; without HUB_PAT_TOKEN the server reads public content only.

tools.notes: Docker's docs also install it from the MCP Toolkit catalog (Docker Desktop 4.43+) or from a clone (node dist/index.js --transport=stdio). The image and its --username argument come from server.json in docker/hub-mcp; no status is stated.

tools.title: Harbor
tools.summary: Open source cloud native registry for container images and Helm charts, with scanning, signing and replication.
tools.notes: No MCP server from the Harbor project found on 2026-11-24 (goharbor GitHub organisation and goharbor.io). Community servers (bupd/harbor-mcp-server, mshegolev/harbor-registry-mcp, oreondev/harbor-mcp) have under 10 stars each and were not registered.

tools.title: Artifactory
tools.summary: Universal artifact repository manager, part of the JFrog Platform with Xray, Curation and Distribution.

servers.name: JFrog MCP Server

settings.name: jfrog_host
settings.description: JFrog: your platform host, without https:// (for example company.jfrog.io)

servers.capabilities: Create and view projects and repositories, find packages, artifacts and builds (AQL), Catalog and Curation status, Xray summaries, violations and CVE impact; Beta tools need enabling.
servers.scopes: The signed-in user's JFrog Platform permissions. Consent: A Platform Admin enables the server on the JPD, then each client completes the OAuth flow.

tools.notes: GA on JFrog Cloud (SaaS) per the jfrog/jfrog-mcp-server README; the self-managed server is Beta and uses an access token. The client config uses type http, so streamable-http is assumed. The older local jfrog/mcp-jfrog is deprecated.

tools.title: Nexus Repository
tools.summary: Artifact and component repository manager for Maven, npm, PyPI, Docker and other formats.
tools.notes: No Sonatype MCP server for Nexus Repository found on 2026-11-24 (help.sonatype.com, sonatype GitHub organisations). Sonatype's own MCP server (mcp.guide.sonatype.com) serves Sonatype Guide dependency data, not Nexus; community Nexus servers (brianveltman/sonatype-mcp, about 8 stars) were not registered.

tools.title: npm registry
tools.summary: Public JavaScript package registry at npmjs.com, with private packages and organisations.
tools.notes: No MCP server published by npm or GitHub found on 2026-11-24 (npm GitHub organisation, docs.npmjs.com). Community servers (YawLabs/npmjs-mcp, OleFabS/npm-Registry-MCP) have under 10 stars and were not registered.
